item.title: Future International Midshipmen Leadership Camp kicks off in China
item.description:
Published: 2026-08-25
YANTAI, Aug. 25 -- On August 24, 2026, the "Future International Midshipmen Leadership Camp" was kicked off in Yantai City, east China's Shandong Province. Hosted by the Chinese PLA Navy and organized by the Chinese PLA Naval Aviation University, the event brings together military cadets from naval academies in Pakistan, Indonesia, Singapore, Vietnam, and other countries. They will train in mixed groups with Chinese naval cadets and take part in a week of interactive and immersive learning and training. The event features over 20 activities, including leadership training, seminars and exchanges, study visits, and traditional Chinese cultural experiences. (Video Editor: Huang Panyue)

item.title: Xi puts forward four principles on Palestinian question
item.description:
Published: 2026-08-24
Chinese President Xi Jinping holds talks with King of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan Abdullah II ibn Al Hussein, who is on a state visit to China, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, capital of China, Aug. 24, 2026. (Xinhua/Li Xiang) BEIJING, Aug. 24 (Xinhua) -- Chinese President Xi Jinping stressed on Monday that four principles should be followed to push for the resolution of the Palestinian question, which is at the heart of the Middle East issue. Xi made the remarks in talks with King of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan Abdullah II ibn Al Hussein in Beijing. First, a political settlement should be upheld. The two-state solution is the right direction, and efforts should be made to restart peace talks between Palestine and Israel, with a view to establishing an independent Palestinian state at an early date, Xi said. Second, the principle of "Palestinians governing Palestine" should be followed in advancing the governance of the West Bank and the post-war reconstruction of Gaza, he said. Third, humanitarian principles must be upheld. The international community, and the UN Security Council in particular, should shoulder its responsibility effectively to protect civilian safety, ensure the flow of humanitarian assistance, and put an end to humanitarian disasters, Xi said. Fourth, fairness and justice must be upheld. This means following international law, addressing both symptoms and root causes, and taking practical actions so that the Palestinian question can be resolved in a comprehensive, just and lasting way at an early date, he said.

item.title: Chinese FM calls on Middle East, Gulf parties to resume dialogue, negotiation
item.description:
Published: 2026-08-24
Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi, also a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, holds talks with Sheikh Jarrah Jaber Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah, Minister of Foreign Affairs of Kuwait, in Beijing, capital of China, Aug. 24. 2026. (Xinhua/Pang Xinglei) BEIJING, Aug. 24 (Xinhua) -- Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi said on Monday that the current situation in the Middle East and the Gulf region is once again at a critical juncture, expressing hope that the parties concerned will return to the track of dialogue and negotiation as soon as possible. Wang, also a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, made the remarks when holding talks with Sheikh Jarrah Jaber Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah, minister of foreign affairs of Kuwait, in Beijing. Wang added the top priority is to de-escalate the situation. Wang said China always attaches great importance to its relations with Kuwait and stands ready to take the 55th anniversary of the establishment of bilateral ties as an opportunity to build a China-Kuwait strategic partnership with a more solid foundation, higher-quality outcomes and greater substance. Wang also expressed confidence that Kuwait will continue to support China's just position on issues concerning its core interests and ensure the safety of Chinese personnel, institutions and projects in Kuwait. Jarrah said Kuwait sincerely appreciates China's long-standing selfless assistance and support for Kuwait in safeguarding its sovereignty and territorial integrity. Kuwait firmly adheres to the one-China principle and is ready to work with China to implement the consensus reached by the two heads of state, Jarrah added. Jarrah noted that Kuwait stands ready to strengthen communication and coordination with China to promote the early restoration of security and stability in the Middle East and the Gulf region, and safeguard the freedom and safety of international waterways. Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi, also a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, holds talks with Sheikh Jarrah Jaber Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah, Minister of Foreign Affairs of Kuwait, in Beijing, capital of China, Aug. 24. 2026. (Xinhua/Pang Xinglei)

item.title: Y-20 Taxies for Takeoff at Dusk
item.description:
Published: 2026-08-24
A Y-20 long-range strategic heavy-lift transport aircraft attached to the Chinese PLA Air Force taxies on the runway under a golden sky during a training exercise on August 3, 2026. The Y-20 is China's first domestically developed new-generation large military transport aircraft. Characterized by long range, heavy payload capacity and high speed, it is capable of conducting long-distance airlift operations for both personnel and cargo under complex meteorological conditions. item.title: China-Indonesia cooperation sets example for Global South: Chinese FM
item.description:
Published: 2026-08-22
Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi, also a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, meets with Luhut Binsar Pandjaitan, chairman of Indonesia's National Economic Council, in Jakarta, Indonesia, Aug. 22, 2026. (Xinhua/Cen Yunpeng) JAKARTA, Aug. 22 (Xinhua) -- Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi said here on Saturday that stronger friendship and cooperation between China and Indonesia have not only promoted their respective development, but also set an example of mutually beneficial cooperation among Global South countries. Wang, also a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, made the remarks when meeting with Luhut Binsar Pandjaitan, chairman of Indonesia's National Economic Council. Wang noted that China sincerely helps Indonesia accelerate its development, encourages and supports Chinese enterprises in continuing to invest and do business in Indonesia, helping the country turn its resource advantages into development momentum and better lives for local people, and accelerate its industrialization process. In this regard, Wang said China hopes and believes that the Indonesian government will provide Chinese enterprises with a safe, stable and sound business environment. Noting that Indonesia-China relations are built on mutual respect, mutual trust and profound friendship, Luhut said bilateral cooperation, particularly Chinese enterprises' investment in Indonesia, has made important and positive contributions to the country's economic development and the improvement of people's livelihoods. Indonesia regards China as its most trustworthy friend and partner, Luhut said, adding that Indonesia always welcomes Chinese enterprises to invest and do business in the country and will provide them with a fair and friendly business environment.
